topic: The command log stores the hook's reported decision
detail: From the SP-041 security audit (low): orchd stores an enforced decision (refused, allowed) and its rule as the hook reports them in RecordToolEvent, without computing its own verdict or comparing guard_enforced with its own switch; any process can only write its own chain. Reserved queue room (D-37) goes only to enforced refusals of pinned sessions and tasks, so unpinned process chains cannot claim it, but a session can still fill its own reserve share with claimed refusals. Proposed: compute orchd's own would-verdict (server.guardVerdict) on the writer goroutine and flag records whose hook decision differs.
